title: NapCatQQ consumer-facade Action argument catalog
$comment: This is a catalog container. Each fixed ActionContract selects one exact $defs fragment; the bound pure validator checks the fragment discriminator, view epoch form, frozen registry/sanitizer bindings, and effective output limits.

OutboundPart.$comment: Outbound QQ text/media uses the ordinary Core Part algebra. In particular, an asset_id inside an ad-hoc JSON segment is not an Asset authorization or reachability edge.

title: NapCatQQ resolved hub or consumer-facade configuration
$comment: Shared definition/catalog resource. A Module MUST bind the role-specific napcatqq-hub-config.schema.json or napcatqq-facade-config.schema.json root, never this union. URI, graph privacy, owner-registry, principal-binding, placement, ingress authority, and aggregate-output relations are additionally enforced by the Host-owned NapCatQQ control/profile validator.

title: NapCatQQ trusted-consumer facade resolved Module configuration
$comment: The napcat-onebot-v11-facade Module type MUST bind this whole root. Host profile admission additionally checks the exact singleton output, exact hub ingress Pages, private subscriber cohorts, same per_extension placement cohort, and distinct storage scopes.

title: NapCatQQ shared-hub resolved Module configuration
$comment: The napcat-onebot-v11-hub Module type MUST bind this whole root. Host profile admission additionally checks per_extension placement, graph/ingress scopes, daemon ownership, and parsed endpoint/network policy.

title: Content-free coalesced NapCatQQ mailbox-change hint
$comment: The target private notification Page identifies the facade/account. The payload deliberately carries no cursor, count, conversation, event class, sender, message, gap, overflow, or media state. Ingress idempotency and coalescing state live outside this payload. This schema closes only the JSON value; org.dolly.validator.napcatqq-profile-admission@1 closes the entire ingress BlockDraft to exactly one such JSON Part, actions:[], and no description/metadata/hints/extra Parts.

title: NapCatQQ successful consumer-facade Action result catalog
$comment: This is a catalog container. Each fixed ActionContract selects one exact $defs fragment. The per-Action validator checks only relations available from the frozen Action/result context. Whole-Block, whole-Action-set, ingress-shape, and authoritative Asset relations belong to the Host-owned NapCatQQ profile-admission validator.

SanitizedValue.$comment: The semantic validator additionally enforces depth, total-node/JCS-byte limits, rejects path/URI spellings, and replays the immutable registry entry's pinned sanitizer and operation-specific result schema.

MediaDeliveryEnvelope.$comment: This value is the first JSON Part in the hub-produced private media ingress Block. The profile-admission validator requires exactly one following Core Asset Part and compares all repeated fields with the authoritative Asset record.

definition.$comment: The named installed closed schema is mandatory and rejects secrets, paths, endpoint credentials, executable code, functions, and live handles.

definition_digest.$comment: sha256(JCS(the complete definition record after removing only definition_digest))

binding_digest.$comment: sha256(JCS(the complete backend-binding record after removing only binding_digest))

candidate_digest.$comment: sha256(JCS(the complete service-candidate record after removing only candidate_digest))

premises_digest.$comment: sha256(JCS(the complete premise record after removing only premises_digest))

relative_path.$comment: Canonical paths use slash separators. The Extension additionally rejects dot/dot-dot segments, resolves beneath the selected canonical Skill root, and rejects platform-equivalent escapes.

ManifestResult.$comment: The Extension additionally enforces that content_hash hashes the UTF-8 manifest bytes and that their byte length is within the frozen resource limit.

ResourceResult.$comment: The bound semantic validator checks decoded data length, offset/returned_bytes/total_bytes, truncation truth, the requested byte range, and configured byte limits.

operation_id.$comment: For host.tool.invoke this equals the invoke operation_id. For host.tool.status this equals the requested target_operation_id, never the fresh status-read operation_id.

allOf.$comment: An unknown external outcome is always represented by the unknown terminal status, never failed or denied.
